text.en: Dog owners speak exceptionally highly of Susan, George, and the daycare team for their genuine dedication and personal warmth. Clients describe a staff that goes far beyond routine minding, offering helpful guidance and reassuring support for new puppy parents. Reviewers emphasize that the team consistently acts with patience, empathy, and professional attentiveness.

Pet parents report that dogs and young puppies thrive in the daycare environment, returning home relaxed, well exercised, and happy. Reviewers note that staff members ensure pets feel thoroughly comfortable before joining group activities, fostering positive socialisation. Owners express deep peace of mind knowing their dogs receive attentive supervision throughout the day.

Clients value the central London setting, which makes dropping off and picking up dogs convenient for city professionals. Reviewers describe a clean, secure, and stimulating environment equipped for dog play, rest, and exercise. Pet owners appreciate the flexible opening hours and the well-maintained indoor layout tailored to canine comfort.

q.en: Does West End Tails offer professional dog grooming alongside daycare?

a.en: Yes, pet owners report high-quality full grooming services, praising groomer George for skilled breed styling and gentle handling.

q.en: How does the daycare help new puppies settle in?

a.en: Reviewers note that the team takes time to ensure new puppies feel safe and comfortable before starting regular attendance.

q.en: What hours are available for daycare drop-off and collection?

a.en: Clients note that the facility operates long, flexible hours suitable for professionals working in Central London.
